articles.title: Ex-LAPD Officer Gets Life Plus 15 Years Over $350K Bitcoin Robbery
articles.snippet: Eric Halem and his crew wore police vests to enter a Koreatown high-rise, then handcuffed a 17-year-old and took his hard drive.

articles.title: Police Have Arrested 37 Americans Over AI Data Center Protests This Year
articles.snippet: Dozens of arrests tied to opposition against AI data centers underscore how local disputes over massive computing projects are growing into a national political movement.

articles.title: Five Convicted of Imprisoning Crypto Millionaires in London 'Torture' Ordeal
articles.snippet: Two of the five were also convicted of conspiracy to blackmail, in a case police won without either victim testifying.
